description.en: Inverted the ratio, computing incidence in the unexposed group divided by incidence in the exposed group instead of the other way round.
description.et: Pööras suhte ümber, arvutades esinemissageduse eksponeerimata rühmas jagatuna esinemissagedusega eksponeeritud rühmas, selle asemel et teha vastupidi.

description.en: Subtracted the unexposed-group incidence from the exposed-group incidence instead of dividing one by the other.
description.et: Lahutas eksponeerimata rühma esinemissageduse eksponeeritud rühma esinemissagedusest, selle asemel et üht teisega jagada.

description.en: Used the exposed-group incidence alone as if it were already the relative risk, ignoring the unexposed-group incidence entirely.
description.et: Kasutas eksponeeritud rühma esinemissagedust üksi, nagu see oleks juba suhteline risk, jättes eksponeerimata rühma esinemissageduse täielikult arvestamata.
